六级大纲词汇 · 14英文原文

Water Under the Door

门缝下流进来的水 · 594 词 · 6 段 · 首次出现的目标词加粗

1Ada came home from an errand and found water coming under the door of her suite. The shabby metropolitan block had a marble stair, a grim hallway, and a bleak concrete terrace. A neighbor beckoned from the landing, clutching a drawer he had pulled out of his wardrobe. Ada slid on a loose tile and caught a sturdy rail. The city's sprawl looked calm. The superintendent was moving dwellers from the lowest floor. In the midst of their shouting she heard an intermittent rattle behind a closet.

2A plumber arrived with a tool bag he could no longer zip. Its broken zipper left a wrench sticking out. He suspected a clog in the plumbing of an annex below the terrace. When he closed the main inlet, water still flushed through a crack and pooled around a wedge. A displaced tenant sobbed as she lifted a box of letters and a tube of lipstick. Ada placed the box on the dry marble ledge. A bead of water rolled from a rusty hinge above it. The pipe might be fed from somewhere the building's plan did not show.

3An older dweller remembered when a Catholic congregation used the annex. Before the cathedral opened, they would congregate there after Easter services. He led the plumber through a detached washroom to a cupboard. Behind it stood a second valve. The plumber had to stoop and grope to reach it. When the handle moved, the murmur behind the wall stopped. An upstairs tenant frowned and asked where he could dwell that night. He had lived in solitude for years, but now his silence worried a neighbor. The ceiling's fragility made the room unsafe. The superintendent's aide marked it off with tape.

4The census listed the annex as a secular meeting room rather than a dwelling. The emergency clerk could not issue a room voucher to a tenant who did not appear on his list. Ada asked him to intervene and showed him a rent receipt. He chose a discreet way to confirm the tenant's plight. He photographed the numbered door, leaving wet clothes and belongings out of the picture. The clerk found a bed near the plaza. The old congregation brought bedding and lotion for a woman who had scraped her hands. Her child began to doze and gave a huge yawn before the clerk finished his report.

5After a sanitary inspection the landlord called the state of the wall appalling. He proposed a quick overhaul. Ada asked him to ventilate first. The hidden valve would stay accessible while a crew worked to rehabilitate the rooms. The plumber marked it with an arrow so future repairs would leave it clear. It took weeks to reconcile the insurer's rules with the building's new plan. The correction averted termination of the lease and let the tenant return. Ada found the woman from downstairs sorting letters. A photograph of her grandmother had survived. She giggled at an adorable dog in one corner. Her grandmother used to adore it.

6On the first evening back, Ada strolled along the terrace with the neighbor who had rescued his drawer. Their earlier cordiality had consisted of a nod. Now her neighbor offered a cordial invitation to tea. He stopped to show her the arrow on the access panel. She saw him wink at the child who had drawn it. She could smell fresh paint and a trace of perfume from the washroom. The repairs were hidden. One useful mark remained in sight. The next tenant would know where to look when the pipes began to rattle.

六级大纲词汇 · 14中文译文

门缝下流进来的水

按英文段落顺序对照阅读

1艾达办完事回家，发现水正从自己套间的门缝下流出来。这栋市区旧楼有大理石楼梯、昏暗的走廊和光秃秃的水泥露台。邻居抱着从衣柜里抽出来的抽屉，在楼梯平台朝她招手。艾达踩到一块松动的地砖滑了一下，及时扶住结实的栏杆。窗外延伸开来的城市看起来很平静。楼管正把住户从最底层撤走。喊声中，她听见壁橱后时断时续的响动。

2水管工带着一个拉不上拉链的工具包来，一把扳手从坏拉链处伸出来。他怀疑露台下方的附楼管道堵了。关掉总进水阀，水还是从裂口冲出来，积在一个楔子周围。一名被迫搬离的住户抱起一盒信和一支口红，忍不住抽泣。艾达把盒子放到干燥的大理石台上。一滴水从台面上方生锈的铰链滚下来。给这根管道供水的地方，可能没画在楼里的管线图上。

3一位住了多年的住户记得，附楼过去供天主教会众使用。大教堂开放前，他们做完复活节礼拜后会聚在这里。他带水管工穿过一间单独的盥洗室，找到一个柜子。柜后还有一只阀门。水管工弯下腰，摸索着够到把手。阀门一动，墙后的低响就停了。楼上一名租户皱着眉问，他晚上该住哪儿。他独居多年，此时的沉默却让邻居担心。天花板已经不牢靠，楼管的助手用警示带把门口隔开。

4普查把附楼登记成世俗活动室，没有列为住宅。应急办事员不能给名单上没有的租户开住宿凭证。艾达拿出租金收据，请他处理。办事员想了个顾及隐私的办法，只拍带编号的门，避开被水浸湿的衣服和私人物品。他在广场附近找到了床位。以前来聚会的人拿来被褥，还给擦伤手的女士带了护理乳。办事员报告还没说完，她的孩子就打起盹，张大嘴打了个哈欠。

5卫生检查后，房东觉得墙面状况很糟，提议马上全面修整。艾达请他先通风。施工队修复房间期间，那个隐蔽的阀门还得够得着。水管工画了个箭头，提醒以后做维修的人别封住它。花了几周，保险公司的规定才和楼里的新方案协调好。登记更正后，租约没有被终止，租户得以回来。艾达看见楼下那位女士在整理信件。她祖母的照片保存了下来，角落里一只可爱的小狗逗得她咯咯笑。那是祖母很疼爱的一只狗。

6搬回来那晚，艾达跟救出抽屉的邻居沿露台散步。过去两人见面只客气地点头，现在邻居热情地请她喝茶。他停下来给艾达看检修板上的箭头，还朝画箭头的孩子眨了眨眼。艾达闻到新油漆的味道，也闻到盥洗室飘出的一点香气。修过的地方藏在墙后，眼前留下一个有用的小标记。下一个租户听到管道响时，就会知道该往哪儿找。
